hints.text: Factoring is distributing in reverse. Start by finding the largest number that divides both terms.
The greatest common factor is $5$. Divide each term by $5$ to find what stays inside the parentheses: $5x \div 5$ and $10 \div 5$.
$5x \div 5 = x$ and $10 \div 5 = 2$, so the factored form is $5(x + 2)$.

explanation: Both terms can be divided by $5$, so $5$ is the greatest common factor.
Write each term as $5$ times something: $5x = 5 \times x$ and $10 = 5 \times 2$.
Pull the shared $5$ out in front of the parentheses to get the factored form $5(x + 2)$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Un-multiply it
steps: Factoring runs distribution backwards: you know the spread-out answer, find what was multiplied.

alternativeExplanations.title: Area model backwards
steps: Picture a rectangle of area 5x + 10 with one side 5.
Split the area into 5x and 10; the other side must be x and 2.
